name: globalHell
description: globalHell was an American hacker group active 1998–2000, one of the first to gain notoriety for mass website defacements and network breaches. The group compromised the White House website, the US Army, Ameritech, and dozens of other organizations, causing an estimated $1.5–$2.5 million in damages. The FBI's National Infrastructure Protection Center prosecuted members in 1999–2000.
